notes: Evals for the LOCAL fork of the shadcn skill. Every prompt is phrased as it would arrive in this repo: a Vite MoBrowser renderer, Base UI (not Radix), lucide icons, base-nova/stone, rsc:false, Tailwind v4 with --radius 0.625rem. Do NOT reintroduce upstream expectations ("use client", tabler icons, asChild, Next.js) — this skill forbids all four. Evals 15–17 test whether the agent's VERIFICATION is honest (crashes invisible to agent console, hidden-window stale state, stale bundle after rebuild); #15 uses the fixture in evals/files/.

evals.prompt: Add a Settings screen: a Profile group (full name, email, job title) and an Appearance group (theme: light/dark/system). Show a validation error on the email field when it's empty.
evals.expected_output: A settings screen composed of FieldGroup/Field horizontal rows inside Cards, with each group's heading ABOVE its card, in <Page size="settings"> (the centered max-w-2xl column).
expectations: Uses FieldGroup + Field for form layout, never a raw div with space-y-*

Each group is a SettingsSection whose SettingsSectionHeader (SettingsSectionTitle + SettingsSectionDescription) sits OUTSIDE the SettingsSectionCard — not a hand-built h2/p, and not CardHeader/CardTitle
No local heading/spacing classes (px-4 insets, gap-8 between groups) — the settings components supply the alignment and rhythm
Rows use Field orientation="horizontal" with the control on the right, and controls are width-capped (~w-64 / max-w-xs), not full-width
FieldGroup inside each card is tightened with className="gap-3" for the compact settings rows
The page is <Page size="settings"> wrapping SettingsPage — not a hand-written mx-auto max-w-2xl wrapper, and not full-width
Validation uses data-invalid on Field AND aria-invalid on the Input
Theme choice is a Select drop-down (with items so the trigger shows the label), capped like the other controls — NOT a ToggleGroup or Toggle inside the settings section
Uses gap-* not space-y-*/space-x-*, and semantic tokens not raw colors
No "use client" directive anywhere (rsc is false in this project)

evals.prompt: Add a dialog for editing a profile: avatar at the top, name and bio fields, Cancel and Save buttons. Save should show a pending state while it's saving.
evals.expected_output: A Dialog with a DialogTitle, an Avatar with a fallback, a real <form> that submits on Enter, and a Save button composed with Spinner + disabled.
expectations: Includes DialogTitle (visible or sr-only) for accessibility
Avatar includes AvatarFallback
The trigger uses the Base UI render prop (e.g. <DialogTrigger render={<Button />}>), NOT asChild
Fields are wrapped in a real <form> with a type="submit" button so Enter submits
Pending state is composed as Spinner + data-icon + disabled — no isLoading/isPending prop on Button
Guards against double submission while the save is in flight
Icons come from lucide-react and carry data-icon="inline-start"/"inline-end" with no sizing classes
Imports use the @/ aliases (@/components/ui/...), not relative paths
No "use client" directive

evals.prompt: Build a Projects screen: a filterable list of projects with a search field, a row action menu on each row, and a Delete action.
evals.expected_output: A list screen using SearchField (Esc clears, clear button), row menu items inside a group, Delete confirmed via ConfirmDialog with undoToast, and table-state rows.
expectations: The filter is the kit's SearchField (Esc clears, ✕ when non-empty) — not a hand-built InputGroup with its own Escape handler
Any other InputGroup in the screen uses InputGroupInput — never a raw Input inside InputGroup
DropdownMenuItem elements are wrapped in DropdownMenuGroup
Menu item labels stay on one line: the row menu is not sized to the ⋯ trigger (no w-(--anchor-width)), uses min-w-* or no width rather than a too-narrow w-*, and items do not wrap
Delete opens the kit's ConfirmDialog (destructive, verb + object label) rather than deleting on a bare click or composing a new AlertDialog
After deleting, calls undoToast with a working Undo

Handles loading, empty, no-results, and error — with the table-state rows (TableSkeletonRows / TableEmptyRow / TableNoResultsRow / TableErrorRow) if it's a table, or Skeleton / Empty / an error path otherwise
Skeleton dimensions match the final row dimensions so there is no layout shift
Shrinking flex children that truncate carry min-w-0
Status uses StatusBadge (or Badge variants) and semantic tokens, never raw colors like text-green-500

evals.prompt: Add a command palette that opens with Cmd+K and from a search box in the top toolbar.
evals.expected_output: A CommandDialog opened from an explicit click/keyboard shortcut — never from the search field's onFocus — with CommandItems inside CommandGroups.
expectations: Uses CommandDialog (or Command inside Dialog) rather than a hand-rolled popup with CommandInput flush against a rounded container
The toolbar affordance is a BUTTON that opens the palette on click — it must NOT open from an input's onFocus (that causes an un-closable reopen loop when focus returns on close)
CommandItem elements are wrapped in CommandGroup
Does not add manual z-index to the overlay
Does not disable or re-implement Esc/outside-click/focus-trap behavior
Any nested rounded surface follows inner_radius = outer_radius - padding using this project's 10px --radius scale (e.g. rounded-2xl + p-2 -> rounded-lg), never the same radius inside and out
Uses Kbd for the shortcut hint rather than a styled span

evals.prompt: Give the app a sidebar with navigation and a top toolbar with the sidebar toggle and a page title. It needs to look right on macOS.
evals.expected_output: A Sidebar with collapsible="offcanvas" whose header clears the traffic lights, and a toolbar that stays flush to the top and shifts right only when the sidebar is hidden.
expectations: Sidebar uses collapsible="offcanvas", not collapsible="icon"
The sidebar header takes a VERTICAL top inset from --titlebar-inset so its logo clears the traffic lights
The toolbar stays flush at the very top — it is NOT padded down by the titlebar height
The toolbar's content shifts right by --titlebar-traffic-width only when the sidebar is collapsed or on mobile, not when it is expanded
Does NOT paste the dashboard-block's vertical Separator between SidebarTrigger and the title/breadcrumb
Window dragging marks the chrome CONTAINERS with app-drag-region and relies on the no-drag carve-out — not a single full-width drag strip laid over the toolbar controls
All of the above is gated on macOS (data-platform="mac"), with the CSS variables at 0 on Windows/Linux
If it changes the toolbar height, it also recomputes setWindowButtonPosition y = (height - 14) / 2 in src/main/index.ts and the CSS variables

evals.prompt: Build a chat view: a scrollable thread of messages from two people with avatars, names and timestamps, a PDF attachment on one message, a 'Today' divider, and a thinking indicator while the assistant replies.
evals.expected_output: A thread composing MessageScroller, Message, Bubble, Attachment and Marker, with the shimmer utility for the thinking state.
expectations: Uses MessageScrollerProvider/MessageScroller/MessageScrollerViewport/MessageScrollerContent/MessageScrollerItem instead of a raw overflow-y-auto div or ScrollArea
Each row is wrapped in MessageScrollerItem inside MessageScrollerContent
Uses Message + MessageAvatar/MessageContent/MessageHeader for row layout instead of custom flex divs
Uses Bubble + BubbleContent for the message surface instead of a styled div with bg-muted/bg-primary
Uses Attachment (AttachmentMedia/AttachmentContent/AttachmentTitle) for the PDF, not Item or a custom card
Uses Marker variant="separator" for the 'Today' divider, not Separator plus a centered span
Uses the shimmer utility for the thinking indicator, not a custom @keyframes or bg-clip-text gradient
Imports these from @/components/ui — it does NOT run npx shadcn add, since they are already installed
No "use client" directive

evals.prompt: Add a stats section to the dashboard (net sales, orders, refunds, each with change vs the previous period), plus a hook that loads the stats.
evals.expected_output: A feature component under components/ composing the kit's MetricGroup + Metric (with Delta via the delta prop), and a hook under hooks/ — nothing new added to components/ui.
expectations: The new component is created under src/renderer/components/<feature>/, NOT in src/renderer/components/ui
It composes the kit's MetricGroup + Metric (delta as a ratio, invert for refunds) — not a hand-built StatCard of Card + Badge + arrow icons
The hook is created at src/renderer/hooks/use-<name>.ts with a use- prefix and kebab-case filename
Imports use the @/ aliases rather than relative paths
Loading uses Metric's loading prop (or Skeleton sized like the final tile), and an error path exists
Values are formatted before being passed to Metric (money from cents, tabular numbers)
Does not hand-edit anything under gen/

evals.prompt: I just built the Projects screen — please check that it renders and works properly.
evals.expected_output: An adversarial verification pass: launch, screenshot, MEASURE overlays, exercise every control, read the console, and report coverage — not a 'looks fine' confirmation.
expectations: Actually launches and drives the app (npm run dev -- --automation or dev:build + agent launch), rather than reasoning about the code alone
Takes a screenshot AND an agent snapshot rather than only type-checking
Measures rounded overlays with agent eval (computed padding/radius) instead of eyeballing them, and treats a near-zero inset gap as a DEFECT rather than 'clean/flush'
Enumerates EVERY interactive control from the snapshot and clicks each one, including menu items inside opened menus and the sidebar profile/account button
When a menu is open, confirms every item is a single line (no wrapped labels; white-space: nowrap, scrollHeight === clientHeight)
For every overlay, verifies it opens, closes on Esc, closes on outside-click, and STAYS closed
Exercises keyboard affordances: Esc clears the filter, Enter submits forms
Reads agent console for error-level entries after interacting and treats any red error as a defect
On macOS, checks the traffic-light keep-out box and the computed -webkit-app-region values, noting that the buttons are native chrome and absent from screenshots
Reports explicit coverage (which controls were exercised), not a vague 'it works'
Reports and fixes defects found rather than declaring success with a known visual or behavioral bug

evals.prompt: Add a product editor page with a Save bar for unsaved changes, and an 'Edit variant' sheet that opens from the variants table with its own form (price, SKU) and a Save button.
evals.expected_output: An editor whose page form and sheet form are independent: submitting the sheet (Enter or its Save button) saves only the variant and leaves the page's unsaved-changes state intact.
expectations: The page-level <form> onSubmit ignores submits that bubbled from nested/portalled forms (checks e.target !== e.currentTarget) and/or the sheet's onSubmit calls e.stopPropagation()
Or the Sheet is rendered outside the page <form> as a sibling, with the reason stated
SheetContent includes a SheetTitle
The sheet's first focusable element is a field, not a Tooltip-wrapped icon button
Save shows a pending state (Spinner + disabled) and can't double-submit
Verification: submits the sheet with Enter and confirms the page's Save bar still shows unsaved changes

evals.prompt: On the analytics page, add a chart comparing net sales and refunds per day for the last 30 days.
evals.expected_output: A two-series bar chart built on ChartContainer/ChartConfig using --chart-2 and --chart-5, direct-labelled or with an adjacent legend, money-formatted tooltip, verified in both themes.
expectations: Uses ChartContainer + ChartConfig with colors var(--chart-2) and var(--chart-5) (not a hex, not a raw Tailwind color, not --chart-3/--chart-4 as the pair)
Passes a formatter to ChartTooltipContent so cents render as money rather than raw numbers
Has a legend or direct labels because there are two series; no dual axis
Has a Skeleton at the chart's aspect ratio while loading and an Empty state when there's no data
Checks the chart in dark mode as well as light (screenshot or measured contrast), not only in light

evals.prompt: Add a notifications bell to the toolbar that opens a list of notifications; clicking one should open the related page. Also add a sort menu with a 'Sort by' label to the orders list.
evals.expected_output: A controlled Popover that closes when an item navigates, a height-capped scroll list, and a DropdownMenu whose label sits inside a group.
expectations: The Popover's open state is controlled and set to false before navigating from an item
The scrolling list is capped on the ScrollArea viewport (or a plain max-h + overflow-y-auto div), not with max-h on the ScrollArea root
DropdownMenuLabel sits inside DropdownMenuGroup (or DropdownMenuRadioGroup) — never directly in DropdownMenuContent
If the sort options are radio items, they pass closeOnClick so the menu closes on choice
The bell trigger is an icon button with an aria-label that includes the unread count

evals.prompt: Build a customers table: name + email (long emails should truncate), orders, total spent, a hover-revealed 'Send email' button, a ⋯ row menu, and right-click on a row for the same actions.
evals.expected_output: Truncation on an inner block (not max-w-0 on the cell), group/row on each row for hover actions, a per-row ContextMenu sharing the ⋯ menu's items.
expectations: Truncates with an inner block (e.g. <span className="block max-w-64 truncate">) — NOT max-w-0 truncate on the TableCell
TableRow has className including group/row, and the hover button uses group-hover/row:opacity-100 plus focus-visible:opacity-100
ContextMenu wraps each row (ContextMenuTrigger render={<TableRow />}), not the whole TableBody
Row menu and context menu items come from one shared definition
Numeric columns are text-right tabular-nums; the ⋯ trigger has a row-specific aria-label

evals.prompt: Build an Invoices list screen: search, a status filter, a date-range filter, sortable Date and Amount columns, pagination, row selection with a bulk 'Mark as paid' action, and loading/empty/error handling.
evals.expected_output: Composed entirely from the app kit: Page + PageHeader/PageTitle, SearchField, FacetedFilter, DateRangePicker, TableCard + SortableHead + TablePagination + useSelection/SelectAllCheckbox/BulkActionBar, table-state rows, StatusBadge.
expectations: Screen is wrapped in <Page> with PageHeader → PageTitle (the only h1); no hand-written mx-auto max-w-* wrapper or <h1 className=…>
Search is SearchField from @/components/ui/search-field — not an InputGroup/Input with its own Escape handler
Status filter is FacetedFilter and the date filter is DateRangePicker — not a hand-built Popover/Select
Sortable columns use SortableHead (+ compareBy); pagination uses paginate + TablePagination; selection uses useSelection + SelectAllCheckbox + BulkActionBar
Non-happy rows use TableSkeletonRows / TableEmptyRow / TableNoResultsRow / TableErrorRow fed one COLUMNS constant; empty and no-results are different
Status cells use StatusBadge with a tone mapped in one place — no per-status className map
No new file duplicates a kit component (e.g. components/shared/search-input.tsx)

evals.prompt: Add a product editor screen at /products/:id with title, price, and an availability date, an activity feed with notes, a 'Delete product' action, and a 'Copy product ID' button. Navigating away with unsaved edits should warn.
evals.expected_output: Routes via @/components/ui/router, Page size detail + PageBack, MoneyInput in cents, DatePicker, SaveBar tied to the form, NavigationGuard mounted once, ConfirmDialog + undoToast, CopyButton, Timeline + NoteComposer.
expectations: Route is registered with Routes from @/components/ui/router (path "/products/:id"); links use Link/navigate — no useState view switch, hashchange hook, or react-router
NavigationGuard is mounted once next to Routes, and the editor uses SaveBar (dirty, onDiscard, form=<form id>) — no hand-rolled sticky save footer or blocker
Price is MoneyInput holding integer cents — not <Input type="number"> with a float
Availability date is DatePicker — not <Input type="date"> or a hand-built Popover + Calendar
Delete uses ConfirmDialog (destructive, confirmLabel "Delete product") and undoToast — not a new AlertDialog composition
Copy uses CopyButton — no direct navigator.clipboard call
Activity uses Timeline + NoteComposer; the page is <Page size="detail"> with PageBack and PageSplit/PageAside

evals.prompt: Mount the ReportsPanel from files/reports-panel.tsx on the app's first screen, then verify that every control in it works. Report what you found.
evals.expected_output: The agent arms a window error/unhandledrejection listener before clicking, clicks all three buttons, and reports Schedule (uncaught TypeError) and Export CSV (unhandled rejection) as defects even though `agent console` stays empty.
expectations: Installs the window.__errors listener (error + unhandledrejection) via agent eval BEFORE exercising the controls, wrapped in an IIFE
Clicks all three buttons (Refresh, Schedule, Export CSV) and reads window.__errors and #root childElementCount after each
Reports Schedule as failing with an uncaught TypeError (reading 'length') and Export CSV as failing with an unhandled rejection ('Export service returned 500')
Does NOT cite an empty `agent console` as evidence that the panel works
Does not claim the panel 'works' or is 'clean'; lists which controls were exercised and which failed

evals.prompt: The app is already running (agent launch) but its window is behind other windows. Verify that the Settings screen's 'Delete workspace' confirmation opens, closes on Escape, and stays closed; include a screenshot of the open dialog.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks document.visibilityState first; because it is 'hidden' it relaunches with the anti-backgrounding flags or brings the window frontmost before trusting overlay state or screenshots, and queries open dialogs with :not([data-closed]).
expectations: Runs agent eval "document.visibilityState" before interpreting any overlay state or screenshot
When it is 'hidden', relaunches with --disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows --disable-renderer-backgrounding (or brings the window frontmost) and re-checks visibility
Checks open state with [role=alertdialog]:not([data-closed]) / [role=dialog]:not([data-closed]), not the bare role
Cross-checks the screenshot against agent eval (e.g. the dialog title text) rather than trusting a possibly stale frame
Does not report 'Escape doesn't close the dialog' as an app bug when the cause was paused transitions in a hidden window

evals.prompt: The app is running via `npm run mobrowser -- agent launch`. Change the Projects screen's empty-state title to 'No projects yet' and confirm the change in the running app.
evals.expected_output: The agent rebuilds with npm run dev:build and RELAUNCHES (agent launch serves the bundle from launch time; location.reload shows the old code), re-arms the error listener, then reads the new text back with agent eval.
expectations: Runs npm run dev:build after the edit
Relaunches the app (agent stop + agent launch) or switches to npm run dev -- --automation — does NOT rely on location.reload() to pick up the new bundle
Confirms the change by reading the text with agent eval / agent snapshot, not only from a screenshot
Re-installs the window.__errors listener after the relaunch before exercising anything
In interactive mode, leaves the app running at the end
